caption:
Your flight is cancelled. You're on your own. There's a queue.

This is the moment most travel books skip. After years on the other side of the desk, here's what I'd say.

Screenshot it. Then you don't have to think of it under pressure. ✈️

And a small announcement: The Brave Itinerary: Solo Travel, Book One, is coming very soon. More on that this week.

#solotravel #solofemaletravel #travelalone #flightcancelled #traveltips #womenwhotravel #booksforwomen #comingsoon

slides.title: Your flight is cancelled. Here's what to say at the desk.
slides.subtitle: Words for the moment it goes wrong.

slides.quote: My flight has been cancelled. I'd like to be rebooked on the next available flight to my destination, and I'd like a hotel voucher and meal vouchers while I wait. Could I have that confirmed in writing, please?
slides.author: Firm · The Brave Itinerary: Solo Travel

slides.heading: Before you go
slides.body:
Save your airline's app and number, your booking reference, your insurer's emergency line and one alternative route.

Your rights depend on where you fly: check the official passenger-rights rules.
